content: This paper presents a novel methodology for simultaneous feature selection and classification of longitudinal functional data with categorical responses, formulating an optimization problem that combines logistic loss with functional features and solving it via functional principal components and an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm. The approach efficiently handles high-dimensional scenarios where features outnumber statistical units, with its effectiveness validated through simulations and a real-data application examining relationships between four chronic diseases and various health and socio-demographic factors.
